Commentary.Commentary: That's a wrap to this one-sided game. The second ODI is on Wednesday, 11th January at 3 pm IST (9.30 am GMT). Do join us in advance for the build-up. Cheers!

Babar Azam, the captain of Pakistan, says that they utilized the new balls perfectly and credits the fast bowlers. Praises his spinners also for executing the plans. Shares that their attempt was to build partnerships as it was not easy for a new batter. Lauds the batting effort of Mohammad Rizwan. He is happy with the bench strength and tells that he has a lot of options in both the pace and spin departments.

Kane Williamson, the captain of New Zealand, says that they would have liked a few more runs on the board. Calls Pakistan clinical with the ball. Adds that in the second half, there was some assistance for the bowlers as well and there is some learning for his team. Mentions that they needed to build more partnerships and need to do things a little better in all departments. Feels that the toss had an impact but refuses to say that it cost them the game as there was assistance for the bowlers in the second innings as well. Wants his team to learn quickly and move on.

Naseem Shah is the Player of the Match for his brilliant spell of 5 for 57 from his 10 overs. The young speedster says that personal performance only counts when you win the game. Praises the effort of all the players. Shares that it was reversing and he just stuck to the right areas.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Agha Salman comes up for a quick chat. Says that it was a tricky surface and feels that 280-290 could have been a tough target. Shares that it was turning the same in the second innings but the reverse swing that Pakistan got, New Zealand didn't, maybe due to the dew factor. Adds that it's always important to win the first game of any series and it has set the tone for them.

Earlier, New Zealand's batting didn't get the kind of fluency needed to put a big total on the board. They kept losing wickets at regular wickets, and that robbed them of momentum. Credit to Pakistan for putting up a disciplined display with the ball and their fielding was also quite impressive. A word of praise for Naseem Shah who was brilliant, both at the start and at the backend, and finished with a 5-wicket haul.

As mentioned earlier, Pakistan were at ease during the chase. Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan played handy knocks and the likes of Haris Sohail and Agha Salman also chipped in with useful runs. An easy win in the end and the hosts will be quite pleased.

The only way to win this game for New Zealand was by picking wickets, and they struggled exactly to do that. Kane Williamson's captaincy was quite ordinary as he persisted with his spinners for a longer period even when they were not able to either take wickets or build pressure. Ish Sodhi could have been handy here and was missed. The other Kiwi bowlers tried hard but there was not enough consistency in their execution. Still, Michael Bracewell looked quite effective whenever he came on to bowl. He had a catch dropped (Fakhar Zaman on 39) off his bowling as well.

Clinical victory for Pakistan! It was a well-planned chase from them, and the home team showed how to bat in these conditions. Partnerships are always the key in any batting inning, and the hosts constructed plenty of stands on their way to the target. New Zealand were pretty much flat with their effort, looked undercooked in both departments and were always behind the 8-ball in this game.

SIX! THAT IS IT! Agha Salman finishes things off for Pakistan! Tim Southee bowls this one on a length outside off, Agha Salman clears his front leg and thumps this one down the ground. Clears the long off fence and collects a maximum. Pakistan win by 6 wickets!
Short of a length around off, Agha Salman guides this one towards third man and takes a single. Pakistan now need 4 off the last two overs.
Short and outside off by Lockie Ferguson, Agha Salman looks to steer this one on the off side but fails to get any bat on it.
Short and at the batter, Mohammad Rizwan works this one from the crease towards deep square leg for a single. 5 needed more off 14 balls.

LBW shout! Not given. Kane Williamson decides to review. Not much excitement shown by the Kiwis. Shortish and around off, Rizwan sits back to pull but misses. He is hit on the right thigh. Nothing on the UltraEdge and it's missing the stumps. New Zealand took the review because they had one.
Back of a length on off, Mohammad Rizwan defends this one back to the bowler.

Short and wide outside off, Mohammad Rizwan slashes this one wide of deep cover and collects a couple of runs. Agha Salman would have been in trouble had Lockie Ferguson collected it cleanly at the non-striker's end.
Good-length delivery outside off, Agha Salman punches it towards deep cover for a couple of runs.

Length delivery on off, Mohammad Rizwan taps it off the back foot towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single. Daryl Mitchell fires a throw a the non-striker's end and ends up hitting Rizwan on the back. Again the players exchange smiles.
Back of a length on off, Agha Salman pushes it towards extra cover and takes a single.

Short of a length around off, Agha Salman tries to pull this one over mid-wicket but gets it from the bottom part of the bat. Skies this one high in the air and the ball drops between the three fielders charging in. Two runs taken.
Good bumper by Tim Southee! Banged in short outside off and keeps climbing on its way to the batter, Agha Salman tries to pull this one but misses.
Length delivery outside off by Tim Southee, Mohammad Rizwan uses the pace and guides it to third man for a single.
Slower and short outside off, Mohammad Rizwan fetches this one and pulls this one towards fine leg. Rizwan wants the second run but has to settle for a single.
On a length and at the pads, Agha Salman tucks this one nicely towards deep square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Banged in short outside off, at 144 kph, Agha Salman looks to cut this one on the off side but misses.
Short and at the batter, Agha Salman fends this one out down the wicket for a dot.
On a length around off, Mohammad Rizwan steers this one from the crease towards third man for a single.
SIX! SHOT! Fuller outside off by Lockie Ferguson, Mohammad Rizwan picks the length early and heaves across the line. Gets plenty of bat on it and it clears the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Agha Salman is the new batter. 24 needed off 30 balls.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tim Southee bangs it in short once again but takes the pace off this time, Haris Sohail looks to pull this one towards mid-wicket but does not get enough on it to clear the fielder in the deep. Mitchell Santner, at wide long on, reacts well and completes the catch diving forward.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Santner b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Short and punished by Haris Sohail! Tim Southee bowls this one on middle and into the wicket, Haris Sohail moves to the leg side and frees his arms. Thumps this one over mid on and collects a boundary.
Short of a length around off, Mohammad Rizwan pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Uppish but safe! Banged in short on middle by Tim Southee, Haris Sohail tries to slap this one on the leg side but gets a top edge that falls short of the fine leg fielder. They cross for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Mohammad Rizwan nudges this one from the crease towards fine leg for a single.

Yet another visit from the physio. Mohammad Rizwan cramps his right leg after playing the last shot. No stretching this time, pickle juice is being consumed. Rizwan is back on his feet once more. 31 needed off 35 balls.
Tim Southee bowls this one on a length outside off, Mohammad Rizwan shimmies down the track and swings at the delivery but fails to get it past mid on. Mohammad Rizwan is down with cramps once again.
Change in bowling. Tim Southee is back into the attack. None for 35 from his 6 overs so far.
Fullish delivery outside off, Mohammad Rizwan drives this one towards deep cover and takes a single.
Mohammad Rizwan is down after turning for the second run. Maybe, cramps. The physio has rushed out. A bit of stretching for Rizwan and he is back on his feet. 32 needed off 37 balls.
FOUR! Streaky but Pakistan will take it! Banged in short at the batter by Lockie Ferguson, Mohammad Rizwan gets cramped for room but still manages to ramp it over the keeper and collects a boundary.
Short of a length and angling in on off, Mohammad Rizwan steers this one straight to backward point for a dot

Banter! Back of a length on off, Mohammad Rizwan blocks this one out down the wicket. The bowler charges towards the ball but Rizwan picks it up and throws on the leg side. Again smiles are exchanged but Ferguson doesn't look amused. Plenty of friendly chatter going around and umpire Aleem Dar wants them to settle down and carry on with the action.
Fuller outside off, Mohammad Rizwan drives this one firmly back to the bowler. Lockie Ferguson fires a throw back at the striker's end but nothing doing. Smiles exchanged.
Short and on middle by Lockie Ferguson, Haris Sohail slices this one towards third man for a single.
Lockie Ferguson is back on. 0 for 32 in 5 overs from the speedster so far.
Fuller outside off, Haris Sohail works it towards covers and takes a single. Michael Bracewell finishes with figures of 2 for 44 from his 10 overs.
Slower and full on off, Haris Sohail defends it to point for a dot.
Short and turning into the pads, Mohammad Rizwan works this one from the crease to square leg. This single brings up the 50-run stand between Sohail and Rizwan.
Short and quicker on off, Mohammad Rizwan rocks back and punches this one wide of deep cover and collects a couple of runs.
Flighted, full on middle, Haris Sohail gets forward and pushes it down to long off for a single.
Fuller and turning in on off, Mohammad Rizwan reverse-paddles this one to short third man for a single.

Back of a length outside off, Mohammad Rizwan tries to slog this one on the leg side but gets it from the upper part of the bat and mishits it to mid on for a single. Daryl Mitchell hits the stumps at the non-striker's end but Rizwan was safely in.
On a length around off, Mohammad Rizwan looks to guide this one fine on the off side but gets an under-edge that goes on the bounce to Tom Latham behind the stumps.
Short and on middle, Haris Sohail pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BANG! Tim Southee bowls this one slower and shorter on middle, sitting up nicely for the batter, Haris Sohail thumps this one wide of long on. Clears the fence with ease and collects a maximum.
On a length on middle by Tim Southee, Haris Sohail makes room to steer this one past backward point but finds the fielder.
Back of a length, angling in on off, Haris Sohail defends this one off the back foot to covers for a dot.
Fuller at the stumps, Mohammad Rizwan clips it to mid-wicket for a dot.

Slower and short on off, Mohammad Rizwan opens the bat-face at the last moment and guides it past the keeper. Daryl Mitchell performs the chase and puts in the dive to prevent the boundary. Two runs taken.
Fuller and angling at the pads, Haris Rauf works this one towards deep square leg for a single.
FIFTY for Mohammad Rizwan! Full on middle, Mohammad Rizwan gets to the ball and drives it down to long on for a single to bring up his fifty.
FOUR! Firmly struck and 200 comes up! Full and around off, Mohammad Rizwan unfurls a beautiful reverse sweep shot and sends it whistling away to the deep point fence.

What happened there? Fuller and outside off by Michael Bracewell, Mohammad Rizwan gets down to reverse-paddle this one but gets hit on his gloves perhaps as the ball lobs in front. Tom Latham dives forward but cannot get to it as Mohammad Rizwan comes in between. It gets stuck on the left flap of his pad and Rizwan is quick to shake it out. Both Latham and Rizwan see the funny side of it. Rizwan was overbalanced there and it was not intentional from him to block the path of the Kiwi keeper
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this match. Michael Bracewell is back on.
SIX! Out of here! A touch short in length and on off, Haris Sohail gets on top of the bounce and deposits it handsomely over mid-wicket for a maximum. 59 needed off 60 balls.
Full and around off, angling in, Haris opens the face of his bat and pushes it to point.
Width there outside off, Rizwan sits back and guides it down to third man for one.
Uses the angle of the bowler and helps it on the leg side, finds short mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, Haris rocks back and steers it through backward point for a run.
Angles in a full ball on off, from 'round the wicket, Sohail defends it off the back foot.
Tim Southee (4-0-19-0) is back on.
Fuller and on middle, Rizwan moves back and eases it to the leg side. The mid-wicket fielder makes the stop to his right. 67 needed off 66 balls.
Fuller and quicker on off, pushed in front of square on the off side for a run.
Skidding down the leg side, it's nudged away towards short 45 for a run. 68 needed off 68 balls.
FOUR! Boom! Tossed up and wide outside off, the length is full and Mohammad Rizwan reaches out for it. He swats it through extra cover and earns a boundary for himself.
Flighted again, full and outside off, Sohail drives it through covers for a single.
Fine shot! Flighted delivery, landing full around off, Rizwan neatly reverse-sweeps it down to third man for three runs.
FOUR! Up and over! A touch short in length and around off, Haris Sohail hangs on the back foot and pumps it over mid on for a boundary. 77 needed off 72 balls.
A dipping full toss around off, Rizwan pushes it off the toe end of his blade to mid on. Crosses for a run.
Drifting down the leg side, Sohail picks it up off his pads and clips it to deep square leg for one.
Too full in length on off, Rizwan forces it down to mid on and scampers across to the other end. The fielder gets a direct hit at the keeper's end but nothing doing.
Henry Shipley comes from 'round the wicket and puts it on a fuller length around off, Sohail slices his drive past backward point. Gets a single.
Short in length and outside off, Rizwan cuts it through cover-point for a single.
Short and on off, Rizwan jumps back and punches it down to long on for one. End of a successful over for the Kiwis!

Uppish but safe! Turning away from the batter, on the shorter side and holding up a bit off the surface, Haris goes back to cut but it takes the toe end of his bat and goes through extra cover. A single is taken.
Tossed up around off, Haris defends it off the front foot to the off side.
Haris Sohail walks in at number 5 for Pakistan.

OUT! STUMPED! Glenn Phillips perhaps senses the charge from the batter and slips a quicker one down the leg side. Babar is down the track, trying to wrist it on the leg side but misses. It probably brushes his pads and it's an excellent take from Latham. He grabs the ball and breaks the stumps in a flash. It's referred upstairs. The third umpire first checks for the edge which is absent. The side-on angle then finds Babar outside the crease. New Zealand have a big opening here. 88 needed off 81 balls.
Commentary.Howout: st Tom Latham b Glenn Phillips

Commentary.Commentary: Stumping appeal has been referred upstairs...
Loopy and outside off, Rizwan goes down to play the reverse sweep but fails to connect cleanly. It takes his gloves and clips the right thigh of Latham before running behind. They cross.
FOUR! Bang! Full toss around off, Rizwan kneels down and powers it over mid-wicket for a boundary. That was begging to be put away!
Serves it short and on middle, Rizwan pulls it through square leg for one. 93 needed more and the run rate has just inched above 6.
Targets the off stump with a full delivery, Rizwan pushes it defensively to covers.
Play and a miss! This one zips off the surface outside off, on a good length, Rizwan flashes and misses.
Back of a length around off, Babar stays back to hit across the line. He places it in front of square leg and crosses.
Digs it in short on off, Rizwan pulls it down to long leg for a single.
Angles in a full ball on off, Rizwan flicks off his pads but finds short mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle, Mohammad Rizwan gets down and scoops this one to the left of the keeper. Lockie Ferguson mops it up at fine leg and they cross.
Full and outside off, Babar Azam uses his feet and drives this one down to long on for a single.
Full outside off, Mohammad Rizwan looks to drive this one on the off side but gets an inside edge that rolls to fine leg. This single brings up the 50-run stand between Rizwan and Babar.
Quicker and fuller on middle, Babar Azam gets inside and sweeps this one towards fine leg for a single.
Full at the stumps, Babar Azam uses his feet to get it past mid-wicket but Michael Bracewell there dives to his right and denies the single.
Fuller outside off by Glenn Phillips, Babar Azam works this one from the front foot to mid-wicket for a dot.

Drinks break. Pakistan continue to hold all the aces. Babar Azam's presence has not allowed New Zealand to create enough pressure and the hosts are on the right path. Another 100 runs are needed and unless New Zealand manage to pick wickets in a heap, they are all set to concede a series lead. Glenn Phillips to bowl after the break...
Beaten! Henry Shipley bowls this one back of a length outside off, Mohammad Rizwan looks to punch this on the off side but misses.
Slower and on a length outside off, Babar Azam works this one from the crease towards deep square leg for a run.
Short around off, Mohammad Rizwan nudges this one towards square leg for a single.
Short of a length on off, Mohammad Rizwan punches this one to covers for a dot.
Back of a length outside off, Babar Azam steers this one along the ground to the right of Tom Latham behind the wickets for a single at third man.
Short and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan cuts this one off the back foot towards deep cover for a run.
Henry Shipley comes back into the attack. 3-1-12-0 are the figures for the debutant so far.

Fuller and at the pads, Babar Azam looks to work it fine on the leg side but misses. The ball hits him on the pads. Mitchell Santner finishes with figures of 0 for 43 from his 10 overs. Quite ordinary on a helpful pitch.
Full and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan knocks this one towards deep cover for a run.
Fullish on middle, Mohammad Rizwan squeezes this one out to covers for a dot.
Full and turning away outside off, Mohammad Rizwan steers this one to point for a dot. Three dots to start the over.
Fuller and quicker on middle, Mohammad Rizwan blocks this one out down the wicket for a dot.
Slower and fuller on off, Mohammad Rizwan defends this one from the front foot to cover.
Short and drifting into the batter, Mohammad Rizwan tucks this one to short fine leg. The fielder there dives to his right and keeps it to one.
Full and at the stumps, Babar Azam works this one towards square leg for a single.
Wide! Glenn Phillips fires this one short but down the leg side, Babar Azam leaves it alone and the umpire signals a wide.
Fuller on middle, Babar Azam tries to defend but gets it from the inner part of the bat towards square leg for a dot.
Shorter and quicker around off, Babar Azam punches this one off the back foot to mid-wicket for a dot.
FOUR! Nicely played! Slower and short outside off by Glenn Phillips, Babar Azam lets the ball come to him and opens the face of his bat to guide it past short third man for a boundary.
Short and on off, Mohammad Rizwan rocks back and pushes this one down to long on for a single.
Flighted, full and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan drives it towards deep cover and takes a single.
Fuller around off, Mohammad Rizwan blocks this one out on the off side for a dot.
Full and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan pushes this one to covers for a dot.
Fullish delivery on middle, Babar Azam drives this one towards deep cover for a single.
Full and drifting at the pads, Mohammad Rizwan rolls his wrists and sweeps this one towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Slower and fuller on middle, Mohammad Rizwan gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Mitchell Santner to continue...
Loopy and full, around off and spinning in, Babar presses forward and defends.
A long hop outside off, Rizwan rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Slightly short and on off, Babar kneels and pulls it to deep square leg for a run. He turns for the second run but Rizwan sends him back.
Flatter and a touch short on off, Rizwan camps back and forces it down to long on for a run.
Fuller and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Serves it full and on middle, Rizwan flicks but finds mid-wicket.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Santner drops his length short around off, Babar Azam pounces onto this gift and pulls it disdainfully over mid-wicket for a boundary. 119 needed off 126 balls.
Fuller and on middle, Babar flicks it to mid-wicket.
Yorker on off, Babar digs it out to the off side.
FIFTY FOR BABAR AZAM! His love affair with the Karachi pitch continues. Short and outside off, Babar cuts it through point for a couple. The crowd applauds for the champion batter.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Turning away from the batter, outside off, Babar goes back and helps it on the leg side but not in the gap.
Flatter on off, Babar moves back and helps it in front of square leg for one. A tidy start from the part-timer. 125 needed off 132 balls.
Fuller and on off, Rizwan this time hits it a lot straighter and beats the dive from the bower. The ball dribbles down to long on and they cross.
Make it three dots. Rizwan is playing from the back foot but is not succeeding in beating the mid-wicket fielder.
Quicker again, around leg, Rizwan moves back and turns it on the leg side but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Very full and sharp around off, Rizwan flicks but finds short mid-wicket.
Begins with a full toss on off, Babar hits it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Glenn Phillips comes into the attack.
Quicker one, short and around leg, Rizwan gets back to work it around but misses. He is hit on the pads. 128 needed off 138 balls.
FOUR! Well played! Short and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan immediately drops his weight on the back leg and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

Appeal for a caught behind, the umpire turns it down. Sharp spin from a fuller length around off, Rizwan is on the front foot as he tries to push it through the line but it whistles past the outside edge. Latham appeals but to no avail.
Fuller and on off, driven off the front foot to short cover.
Loopy delivery, full and drifting on middle, Rizwan defends it off the front foot.
Fires it full and down the leg side, Rizwan plays his favourite sweep shot but finds short fine leg.

Superb fielding! Ferguson serves another short delivery outside off, Babar stays inside the crease and guides it through backward point. The ball races away and so does Michael Bracewell from third man. He makes a diving stop near the fence and saves two runs for his side. 132 needed off 144 balls.
Short in length and outside off, at 145 kph, Rizwan stands back and steers it past point for a single.
Fuller and on middle, at 149.2 clicks, eased down to mid on.
Back of a length outside off, Babar uses the pace and runs it down to third man for a run.
A touch short and on off, Babar plays late and taps it down to point.
Digs it in short around off at 145.6 kph, Rizwan plays a mistimed pull shot to square leg for a run.

Short and turning away outside off, Babar Azam pushes this one uppishly towards short point and it falls just short of the fielder. Babar is surprised, perhaps he was unaware that a fielder is positioned there!
Fuller outside off, Mohammad Rizwan drives this one down to long off for a single.

Shout for an lbw, the finger stays down. Kane Williamson looks around and then decides to take the review at the last moment. Santner gets a full ball to skid in from the middle stump line, Mohammad Rizwan is forward to defend but misses. He is pinged on the front pad and New Zealand put in an unsuccessful appeal. DRS time. Ball Tracking shows that it's clipping the leg stump and it's the umpire's call. The crowd roars.
Short on middle, Babar Azam works this one wide of backward square leg and takes a single.
Short and outside off, Babar Azam tries to pull this one but cannot get it past backward square leg.

Beauty! Mitchell Santner bowls this one slower and fuller on middle, the ball spins away sharply and goes the past outside edge of Babar Azam as he tries to defend. Babar appreciates the ball and gives a thumbs up to Santner.
Mitchell Santner comes back into the attack. 0 for 27 in his 5 overs so far.

FOUR! Nicely timed! Full in length outside off by Lockie Ferguson, Mohammad Rizwan lets the ball come to him and drives this one along the ground. Gets it past cover and times it too well to collect a boundary.
Beaten! Lockie Ferguson bowls this one on a length outside off, and Mohammad Rizwan pokes at the delivery away from his body. Gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short on off by Lockie Ferguson, Babar Azam tucks this one towards deep square leg for a single.
Short of a length on off, at 148.4 kph, Babar Azam pulls this one half-heartedly over mid-wicket and collects a brace.
Short and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan gets hurried as he tried to pull and the ball comes off his gloves. It rolls towards fine leg for a single.
Back of a length around off by Lockie Ferguson, Mohammad Rizwan blocks this one out down the wicket for a dot.
Short outside off and a hint of turn into the batter, Mohammad Rizwan stays back and pushes this one to the right of the bowler. Opens his account with a single.
Mohammad Rizwan is the new batter. 148 needed off 163 balls.

OUT! TIMBER! Michael Bracewell bowls this one quicker and fuller at the stumps, the ball drifts in with the angle. Fakhar Zaman gets down on one knee to slog sweep this one on the leg side but misses it altogether. Ends up getting his woodwork rattled. A much-needed breakthrough for New Zealand as this partnership was taking the game away from them. They need to capitalize on this opening to make a comeback.
Full on middle, Fakhar Zaman gets inside and sweeps this one towards deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Full outside off by Michael Bracewell, Fakhar Zaman pushes it to cover for a dot.
Fuller outside off, Babar Azam gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to the left of mid-wicket. A half-stop by Finn Allen allows the batters to take only single.
Short and turning in on off, Babar Azam rocks back and punches this one to the right of deep cover for a couple of runs.
Good bumper! Banged in short outside off, at 143 kph, Fakhar Zaman tries to fetch this one from outside off and pull it on the leg side but misses.
Back of a length on off, Fakhar Zaman tries to steer this one past backward point but finds the fielder.
Short and outside off, Fakhar Zaman looks to punch this one but gets it from the bottom part of the bat towards covers for a dot.
Short of a length around off, Babar Azam stays on the back foot and guides this one towards third man for a single.
Banged in short on middle by Lockie Ferguson, Fakhar Zaman pulls this one along the ground towards deep square leg for a single.
Edgy but safe! Back of a length around off, Babar Azam tries to work this one on the leg side and closes the bat-face early. Gets a leading edge that flies towards third man for a single.
Change. Kane Williamson has decided to feed some pace after a long period of spin. In comes Lockie Ferguson.
Fuller and outside off, Fakhar Zaman defends this one to point for a dot.
Fuller outside off by Michael Bracewell, Babar Azam uses his feet and works this one towards deep mid-wicket. This single brings up the 100 for Pakistan.
Fuller and quicker on leg, Fakhar Zaman pushes this one down to long on for a single.
Short and turning away outside off, Fakhar Zaman taps it straight to point for a dot.
Slower and fuller on off, Fakhar Zaman gets forward and blocks it out back to the bowler.
Short and turning in around off, Babar Azam goes back and punches it to deep cover for a single.
A little turn into the batter from around off, Fakhar softly plays it to square leg. A dot ball to finish the over. 159 needed off 180 balls.
Fuller and on off, Fakhar brings out the reverse but finds short third man.
Spinning in from around off, Fakhar tries to defend but gets an inside edge. It goes closely past the leg stump.
FOUR! Fifty for Fakhar Zaman! Flighted delivery, full and wide outside off, Zaman leans forward and crunches it through point for a boundary. His 5th fifty in ODIs against the Kiwis.
Fires it in, flat and short around middle, Babar moves back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery, outside off, Babar lunges and wristily pushes it to point.
Short and on off, forced off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter on off, Zaman goes back and punches it to the bowler.
Slows it up around off and gets it to spin away, Fakhar plays late and taps it down to point.
Short again, outside off, this time Babar cracks it square of the wicket on the off side and runs the first run hard. He turns for the second run but then screams no.
Babar Azam is experiencing some discomfort in his abdominal muscle and needs medical attention. Seems like he is having trouble breathing but looks fine to resume.

FOUR! Put away! A long hop around off, turning in, Babar goes on the back foot and pulls it with authority to the deep square leg fence. He seems to have done some damage to his body, rubbing the abdominal muscle. Hopefully, nothing serious. 165 needed off 190 balls.
Shortish and on off, punched off the back foot to short mid-wicket.

Time for Drinks! Pakistan are going along nicely in the chase with Fakhar Zaman and Babar Azam in the middle. Both batters are looking at ease and are keeping the scoreboard ticking. On the other hand, New Zealand have tried hard to break this partnership but have failed to get any success. They have dropped Fakhar Zaman once and had an LBW decision overturned against Babar Azam. They need a breakthrough soon to get back into the game.
Floated and on middle, fuller in length, Babar wrists it behind square leg and picks up a single.
Extra loop on this delivery as it lands full and outside off, Babar drives but finds the fielder at short cover.
Fuller and on the pads, it's quietly turned to deep square leg for a single.
Three dots now. Loopy and full, around off, Zaman defends it off the front foot to mid-wicket.
Gets forward to drive but it takes the inner half and goes to short mid-wicket.
Too full and on off, Fakhar mistimes his flick shot off the toe end. It rolls to the leg side.
Very full and on off, Fakhar drives it through mid off for a run. 171 needed off 198 balls.

NOT OUT! Fuller in length and just outside off, Babar kneels down to paddle sweep but misses. It clips his pads and rolls towards short fine leg. The bowler appeals and the batters cross. Kane Williamson takes the DRS. The Ball Tracking finds the impact to be outside the line. New Zealand lose one review.
DRS time. Appeal for an lbw against Babar Azam has not been entertained. Kane Williamson has reviewed the decision.
Floats it up and lands full outside off, Babar presses forward and across in defense.
Fuller and on off, eased past the bowler to long off for one.
Gets on the front foot and drives a full ball to covers.
Flatter and on off, Fakhar punches it down towards mid on and the short mid-wicket fielder stops it by moving across to his right.
Full around off, Fakhar flicks it with soft hands to short mid-wicket where the fielder dives but fails to collect the ball cleanly. They cross.
Shortish and on middle, Babar moves back and turns it through mid-wicket for a run.

Given lbw! Babar Azam has reviewed the decision. Santner comes up with an arm ball, lands it on a fuller length around off and gets it to skid into the batter. Babar strides forward to defend but misses and is pinged on the front pad. DRS time. Nothing on the UltraEdge and the Ball Tracking shows that it's missing the stumps. The on-field decision has been overturned and the crowd roars.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it back.
Quicker one, around off, helped behind square leg for a run. The 50-run stand comes up.
Short and outside off, turning away with extra bounce, Babar goes back and forces it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Floated, full and outside off by Michael Bracewell, Fakhar Zaman gets inside the line of the delivery and sweeps this one towards deep backward square leg for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Fakhar Zaman pushes it to covers for a dot.

DROPPED! Michael Bracewell bowls this one slower and fuller outside off, Fakhar Zaman gets forward to defend but the ball spins away and takes the outside edge. Tom Latham behind the wickets fails to grab it and Fakhar Zaman breathes a sigh of relief.
Short and turning in on middle, Babar Azam plays it with the turn and works it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Fuller around off by Michael Bracewell, Babar Azam defends this one back to the bowler.
FOUR! Swept away clinically! Floated delivery, full and around middle, Babar gets down and across to sweep and despite losing his bottom hand, he nails it behind square leg for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Babar goes back and forces it down to long on for a single.
Full outside off, Fakhar Zaman drives this one towards covers for a single.
Short at the stumps by Mitchell Santner, Babar Azam works this one towards short fine leg and a fumble there by Henry Shipley allows the batters to cross for a single.
Slower and a touch fuller around off, Babar Azam tries to defend this one but gets beaten by the turn.

Short and drifting at the pads, Babar Azam looks to pull this one from the crease but gets hit high on the pads. The ball lobs off his pads and takes the gloves before dropping in front of the keeper.
Short around off by Mitchell Santner, Fakhar Zaman works this one from the crease towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Floated, full around off by Michael Bracewell, Fakhar Zaman drives this one down to long off for a single.
Full and outside off, Fakhar Zaman defends it to point for a dot.
Fuller and on off, staying low, Babar helps it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, Babar Azam makes room to cut this one but gets an under edge that sneaks past the off stump. Could have easily dragged it on.
Short and turns in sharply on off, Babar Azam looks to cut it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller around off by Michael Bracewell, Babar Azam gets inside and flicks it to short fine leg for a dot.
Quicker one, full and on off, pushed back defensively.
Fuller outside off, Babar Azam gets forward and pushes it to covers for a single.
FOUR! Mitchell Santner shortens his length and bowls it on middle, Babar Azam picks the length early and pulls this one towards deep backward square leg for a boundary. Easy going for Pakistan!

SIX! Dispatched by Babar Azam! Mitchell Santner floats this one, full around off, Babar Azam gets down on one knee and slogs this one towards the deep mid-wicket fence. Clears the fence and collects a maximum.
Fuller and sliding in on middle, Babar Azam pushes this one to mid-wicket for a dot.
Mitchell Santner starts with a flighted delivery, full on middle, Fakhar Zaman clips this one towards deep square leg for a single.
Short at the stumps, Babar Azam stays in the crease and punches it to mid-wicket for a dot.
Sharp turn! Slower and short, turning in on middle, cramps the batter for room and Babar Azam blocks this one out from the inner edge.
Short on off by Michael Bracewell, Babar Azam can only push this one to mid-wicket for a dot.
Short and turning in on off, Babar Azam goes back and pushes it straight to mid-wicket for a dot.
Short around off, Fakhar Zaman taps it off the back foot to point for a quick single. There's a direct hit at the bowler's end but Fakhar is safely in.
Short and outside off by Michael Bracewell, Babar Azam lets the ball come to him and guides this one to the left of short third man for a single. 50 comes up!
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Michael Bracewell comes back into the attack.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length around off, Fakhar stays back to swipe across the line but misses. At the end of the Powerplay, Pakistan are 49 for 1. 207 needed off 240 balls.
Angles in a length ball on middle, 148.6 kph, Babar works it through mid-wicket and takes three runs.
On a length and around off, nearly 148 clicks, Fakhar plays it close to his body and taps it down to backward point for a single.
EDGY FOUR! Flashes and flashes hard. Short in length and wide outside off at 146.1 kph, Fakhar throws his hands at it and edges it down to third man for a boundary.
Short again, angling down, Fakhar pulls from the inner half to short fine leg. Got hurried up!
Short and wide outside off, at 146.5 kph, Fakhar plays a mistimed square cut to backward point.
Edgy! Shipley ships this delivery on a fuller length around off, Babar attempts to flick but gets a soft leading edge. The ball rolls away to the cover fielder. A maiden!
Width there outside off, short in length, Babar reaches out and hits but finds the fielder at point.
Slants a length ball around off, Azam defends it off the back foot.
Short and on off, Babar goes back and pulls but finds the fielder at mid-wicket. Misses out.
Fullish and around off, Babar drives it off the front foot to mid off.
Beaten! Henry Shipley delivers it on a length outside off, Babar tries to drive but is beaten on the inside edge.
Henry Shipley comes back on, replacing Tim Southee.
Good energy on this ball, short and wide outside off at 145.7 kph, Fakhar tries to slam it over point but misses.
FOUR! Delightful! Fuller in length, around off and angling in, Fakhar presents the full face of his bat and eases it down through mid on for a boundary.
Finds the fielder. Short in length and wide outside off, 145.4 kph, Zaman slaps it off the back foot and Finn Allen makes a diving stop to his left at backward point.
On a length around off, Fakhar goes on the back foot and defends it to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Well played! Used the pace and the angle of the bowler. Length delivery on middle, at 142.9 kph, Fakhar stays back and works it stylishly through square leg for a boundary.
Shortish and on off, at 143.5 kph, Fakhar goes on the back foot and plays it down to short cover.
Lockie Ferguson is introduced into the attack.
Pitches it up and outside off, Babar is forward and he defends it with a loose bottom hand to mid on.
Back of a length, around off, Fakhar pulls it through square leg for a single.
Short in length, on off at 133.4 kph, Fakhar stands back and taps it down to point.
Puts it on a length around off, Fakhar tries to play it with the angle but it takes the inner half and rolls to mid on.
Another delivery has been angled into the batter, around off, Fakhar shows the full face of his bat and pushes it past the bowler to mid off.
Angling down the leg side, Fakhar clips it through square leg and takes a couple of runs.
Fullish and around off, Babar plays a crunchy drive off the front foot but finds the fielder at short cover.
Slow spin back into the batter, from around off, Babar defends it off the front foot.
Babar Azam comes in at number 3 for Pakistan.

OUT! CAUGHT! The change in bowling has worked for New Zealand. Michael Bracewell delivers a slider, around middle and off, at 85.6 kph, Imam-ul-Haq steps down the track for a big shot over mid on but mistimes it badly off the inner portion of his bat. It flies straight into the hands of Henry Shipley inside the ring. A much-needed breakthrough for the Black Caps but they need to keep chipping away at the wickets to stay in the hunt.
Commentary.Howout: c Henry Shipley b Michael Bracewell

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted and full, around off, Imam is on the front foot in defense.
Eases a full ball through mid off for a single.
Flatter and outside off, Zaman tries to drive but gets a bottom edge. It goes behind to the keeper on one bounce.
Change.
Michael Bracewell comes into the attack.
Back of a length and angling in on off, Fakhar Zaman works this one down to third man for a single.
Tim Southee shortens his length and bowls it on off, Fakhar Zaman taps it off the back foot to point for a dot.
FOUR! Tim Southee pitches this one full and on leg, Fakhar Zaman drives this one along the ground and to the right of mid on for a boundary.
Short of a length around off, Imam-ul-Haq stays back and guides it to third man for a run.
On a length outside off, Fakhar Zaman opens the bat-face and steers this one down to third man for a single.
Back of a length outside off by Tim Southee, Fakhar Zaman punches this one off the back foot but straight to point for a dot.
On a length outside off, Imam-ul-Haq drives this one on the up but fails to get it past cover.

FOUR! Nicely played! Henry Shipley bowls this one too full and on off, Imam-ul-Haq picks the length early and presents a full face of the bat. Drives it to the left of the bowler and it goes for a boundary.
Fuller on middle by Henry Shipley, Imam-ul-Haq tries to work it on the leg side but mishits it towards mid off for a dot.
Length delivery outside off, Imam-ul-Haq defends this one from the crease to extra cover for a dot.
On a length on middle, Fakhar Zaman turns this one towards deep square for a single.
Fuller and on middle by Henry Shipley, Fakhar Zaman works this one towards deep backward square leg and collects a couple of runs.
Back of a length outside off, a hint of inward movement, Imam-ul-Haq carefully lets it go to the keeper.
Good-length delivery around off, Imam-ul-Haq defends this one to Finn Allen at point for a dot.
Full at the pads by Tim Southee, Fakhar Zaman flicks this one along the ground towards deep square leg for a run.
Fullish delivery outside off, close to the tramline, Fakhar Zaman leaves it alone.

Full and shaping into the batter on middle by Tim Southee, Fakhar Zaman rolls his wrists and clips it through mid-wicket. Devon Conway runs to his right and makes a good tumbling stop to keep it to two.
Tim Southee bowls this one full on off, Fakhar Zaman pushes this one with a straight bat to mid off for a dot.
On a length on middle by Henry Shipley, Fakhar Zaman nudges this one towards fine leg and takes a single.
Back of a length on off, Fakhar Zaman blocks this one out to mid-wicket for a dot.
Full around off by Henry Shipley, Fakhar Zaman defends this from the front foot to point for a dot.
FOUR! Henry Shipley bowls this one full and at the pads, Fakhar Zaman does not miss out and clips this one through square leg and collects his first boundary.
On a good length around off, defended back.
Shortish and outside off, left alone.
Debutant Henry Shipley to bowl from the opposite end. He is a tall young man and can extract some extra bounce from the surface.
Straighter in line, Imam works this length ball through square leg for a couple of runs. A good start from Pakistan.
Close to off and on a good length, Imam defends it from the back foot.
Angling away from the batter, on a length, Imam shoulders arms.
Full on middle by Tim Southee, Imam-ul-Haq pushes this one back to the bowler.

FOUR! Imam-ul-Haq is up and running! Tim Southee bowls this one full at the stumps and swinging into the batter, Imam-ul-Haq gets in the line of the delivery and drives it to mid on. The fielder, Lockie Ferguson, lets it go through his legs and concedes a boundary.

APPEAL FOR AN LBW! Tim Southee starts with a full delivery, swinging into the batter, Fakhar Zaman looks to clip this one but misses. A loud shout by New Zealand as the ball strikes Fakhar Zaman on the front leg. The umpire is unmoved and New Zealand decide not to review. Pitching outside leg. The batters had crossed for a leg bye.
